title: Finite affine chart factorization and interval gluing
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. There are finite affine open covers $(V_i)$ of $Y$ and $(U_{ij})_j$ of each $f^{-1}(V_i)$ such that the restricted morphism $U_{ij}\to V_i$ factors as a closed immersion $U_{ij}\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^{m_{ij}}_{V_i}$ followed by the smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] separated affine-space projection [def-sbc-affine-space] of relative dimension $m_{ij}\ge0$. All schemes in these factorizations are separated and of finite type over $k$. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Suppose each $K|_{U_{ij}}$ has constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] in an interval $[r_{ij},s_{ij}]$ and Tor amplitude $[a_{ij},b_{ij}]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Then $K$ is bounded constructible, with cohomological interval $[\min r_{ij},\max s_{ij}]$ and Tor amplitude $[\min a_{ij},\max b_{ij}]$ if $X$ is nonempty. If $X$ is empty, $K=0$ and every interval is valid.
